page.layout: One printed page. Running head and page number at the top. Above the two columns: continuation text at full width, then the section number "4." Below that, two parallel columns, "Veteres." on the left and "Hodierni." on the right, with the catchword and signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: tum ab aliis episcopis promovebantur; aliquando à meris presbyteris: & si concederetur Timotheum fuisse ordinarium Episcopum; consecratio tamen non fuit per Archiepiscopum, nec Episcopum, sed per coetum presbyterorum. 1. Tim. 4: 4. Ab abbatibus insulae S. columbani qui Presbyteri tantum fuerunt, refert Beda histor. lib. 3. cap. 5. Episcopum electum & missum fuisse Arcanum.

Nullam aliam agnoverunt confecrationem seu ordinationem quam presbyterorum ef-fet. Episcopi & presbyteri una & eadem est ordinatio, inquit Ambrosius, in 1. ad Timoth. cap. 3. & Albinus Alcuinus (natione Scotus qui floruit favore & gratia Caroli magni ad quem ab Achajo Scotorum rege missus fuit circa annum 800. & cujus opera aperta primum fuerunt Academia, Parisiensis in Galliis, & Ticinensis in Italia: hic) libro 3. De divinis officiis sic loquitur. Qualis autem esset antiquitus consecratio Episcoporum ostendit Hieronymus in epistola ad Evagrium, Alexandriae inquiens, à Marco Evangelista usq; ad Heraclam & Dionysium episcopos, presbyteri semper unum ex se electum, in excelsiori gradu collocatum Episcopū nominabant, quomodo si exercitus imperatore faciat, & Diaconi eligant de se quem indu-
Diversam habent confecrationem à presbyteris: quia ordine dif-ferre se dicunt à Presbyteris.

page.notes: The right column "Diversam habent..." is a short paragraph in the Hodierni column, set beside the left column. The catchword "ftrium" is at the foot right. Italic on the Latin book citations and "in epistola ad Evagrium" is judged from the scan and may be imperfect. The mark "1. Tim. 4: 4." is part of the running line, not a note. Show-through and dark edge marks at the margins are not transcribed.
